description: Environmental Resilience Tools Wizard is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by EPA, U.S. Environmental Protection Agency. Emergency managers and others can filter by audience, topic, disaster stage, and/or resource type to zero in on relevant resources from EPA. Available tools can help build community resilience to disasters or address concerns in disaster mitigation, preparedness, response, and recovery. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Air Quality, Drought, Flooding – General, Water Quality. Assets: Critical Facilities, Energy and Utilities, People, Property, Transportation and Mobility, Water Infrastructure – General. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
